notes.title: Major Demo Update! Gearing up for Next Fest
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44759243/7947ef65952f34b71c8351d91976e17de7b9133f.png[/img]

Hey everyone! As we gear up for Steam Next Fest on Feb 5th - 12th, we've released the newest, best version of the demo to really make a splash! 

If you haven't already, [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/572883522/star-deck]please follow the Kickstarter here[/url].

We added some new cards to the Blaster deck to give it a bit more [i]OOMPH[/i] since the hammer was getting a bit too much love.

Stay tuned in the next 2 weeks for our live stream announcement schedules during the event.

List of fixes in current build:

[list]
[*]Added battle VFX
[*]Added in Chromatic Aberration & Vignette to Post FX for damage triggers
[*]Cool new EDM soundtrack!
[*]Fix persistent bug on boss music transition
[*]Fix bug with hand being dealt after battle has been won
[*]Fix bug with boss killing you if your counter kills him first
[*]Updated the Main Menu BG & Title
[*]Finally fully completely actually fixed so music doesn't play same track between battles
[*]Replaced HUD block icon to be UI Image so it doesn't have character shadow on it
[*]Changed damage animation & font
[*]Changed Next Action font
[*]Increased screen shake on damage triggers
[*]Added shadow for Amor Bot
[*]Fix description on Clip Extender item for readability
[*]Added cast animations for ArmorBot & DroneBot
[*]Added SFX for Blind & Taunt
[*]Improve hand deal time at battle start
[*]Add coin SFX to ATM event
[*]Boss health bar stays after battle wins for consistency
[*]Fix demo completion screen
[*]Fix font issue with End Turn button in battles
[*]Fix DroneBot stun animation position
[*]Fix Heal font & animation
[*]Fix Rob Attack Buff noise
[*]Clean up card text alignment, add Italicized text for the flavortext, shrink weapon icons on cards
[*]Add Powers status icon in the character HUD, and in status hover description
[*]New music! spice it up
[*]Fix options menu to work on opening scene & weapons menu
[/list]

Card changes:

[list]
[*]Refactor Final Blow code for code cleanup (much cleaner now)
[*]Pulse no longer uses ammo
[*]Pulse artwork change
[*]Laser Shot: 5 -> 6 damage
[*]NEW Card, Concentrated Blast: Double damage of next Blaster attack (1 cost, Uncommon, Blaster)
[*]NEW Card, Blaster Amplifier: Blaster attacks do +3 damage this turn (1 cost, Common, Blaster)
[*]NEW Card,  Pulse Shot: Do 15 damage, draw a Pulse (2 cost, Common, Blaster)
[*]NEW Card,  Pulse Charge: When you play a pulse, gain +1 ammo (1 cost, Uncommon, Blaster)
[*]NEW Card,  Echoed Discharge: Draw 3 Pulses (1 cost, Rare, Blaster)
[*]Renamed Pulse Amplifier-> Pulse Fabricator
[*]Pulse Fabricator now also gives a Reload when played
[*]Removed 1 Force Field, 1 Energy Cell, 1 Laser Shot, 1 Ice Slam, and 1 Frozen Shield from starting deck
[/list]

As always, [b]THANKS FOR YOUR SUPPORT! WE CAN'T WAIT FOR NEXT FEST LET'S GOOOOOOO!!!![/b]

notes.title: Star Deck demo now available!
notes.content:
Thanks for checking out my game! The demo has finally arrived. 

Be sure to follow the Kickstarter here [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/572883522/star-deck]Star Deck Kickstarter Page[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/PsychedStudi0s]follow me on twitter for more frequent updates[/url]!

Not sure if a prior demo was on my page as I look at the analytics, it looks like the game was downloaded several thousand times in the past week so THANK YOU ALL!!!

Keep in mind, there were some confusing bugs in the prior versions. 

[b]Bug fixes since the last update:
[/b]
[list]
[*] You now visit the weapon shop (with tutorials) from the intro dialogue scene if it isn't skipped
[*] Fixing some loud audio sounds in the intro dialogue scene (sorry!)
[*] Fixed intro text for the Map to wait on click 
[*] Added Space Dust TM atmospheric fun to all battle & chest scenes!
[*] Added Options Menu in the game (saving is still not avail, sorry)
[/list]

Thanks everyone for their interest and support in this project! I hope to crowdfund and get enough to continue working on the game for the next year and a half, let's make it a reality! ːsteamhappyː
